name: Docusign
description: Typed eSignature v2.1 accounts, users, draft/send envelopes, recipients, tabs, templates, document metadata, audit, folders and brands.

permissions.description: Fixed allowlisted Docusign HTTPS eSignature endpoints; external bearer OAuth. Exact confirmation for every external mutation including drafts, sending, reminders and sensitive signing-view creation. No filesystem, refresh, signing, listeners or retries.

definitions.name: Docusign Get Account
definitions.documentation: Docusign Get Account: GET /restapi/v2.1/accounts/{configured accountId}. Externally issue OAuth access token with signature scope and endpoint/account entitlements; acquisition/refresh and account base discovery are external. Set exact allowed baseOrigin and accountId in node config or RuntimeConnection.config via builtin $connection; access token from credentials.accessToken or DOCUSIGN_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret. Per-node timeout 100–30000ms (default10000), beginning before profile/secrets through awaited successful stream cancellation. Profile timeoutMs does not extend the node deadline. Fixed routes/hosts, redirects forbidden, one request only, retries=0. Arguments use direct typed sockets and the complete original request validator before credentials; result projects known typed fields only. DocuSign boolean flags/counters/IDs/tab values retain exact provider strings; optional absence differs from explicit null where declared. Response numeric JSON supports only lossless safe integer tokens; rejects fractional/exponent/unsafe tokens, even in unknown fields. Strict Unicode/UTF-8, dense JSON, depth40,100000 items, response1MiB/8192 chunks, lists100 unless documented nested bound. Paging count<=100 and start_position are explicit, defaults count100; returned nextUri is data only, never followed. Folder API has provider-defined page size; explicit start_position, no count/auto iteration. Metadata only, no document download or signed binary. No Connect listeners, signing, OAuth, auto send, arbitrary proxy, refresh, retries or auto pagination. Example: {}. definitions.documentation: Docusign List Envelopes: GET /restapi/v2.1/accounts/{configured accountId}/envelopes. Externally issue OAuth access token with signature scope and endpoint/account entitlements; acquisition/refresh and account base discovery are external. Set exact allowed baseOrigin and accountId in node config or RuntimeConnection.config via builtin $connection; access token from credentials.accessToken or DOCUSIGN_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret. Per-node timeout 100–30000ms (default10000), beginning before profile/secrets through awaited successful stream cancellation. Profile timeoutMs does not extend the node deadline. Fixed routes/hosts, redirects forbidden, one request only, retries=0. Arguments use direct typed sockets and the complete original request validator before credentials; result projects known typed fields only. DocuSign boolean flags/counters/IDs/tab values retain exact provider strings; optional absence differs from explicit null where declared. Response numeric JSON supports only lossless safe integer tokens; rejects fractional/exponent/unsafe tokens, even in unknown fields. Strict Unicode/UTF-8, dense JSON, depth40,100000 items, response1MiB/8192 chunks, lists100 unless documented nested bound. Paging count<=100 and start_position are explicit, defaults count100; returned nextUri is data only, never followed. Folder API has provider-defined page size; explicit start_position, no count/auto iteration. Metadata only, no document download or signed binary. No Connect listeners, signing, OAuth, auto send, arbitrary proxy, refresh, retries or auto pagination. Example: {"from_date":"2026-10-01T00:00:00Z"}. definitions.documentation: Docusign Create Draft Envelope: POST /restapi/v2.1/accounts/{configured accountId}/envelopes. Externally issue OAuth access token with signature scope and endpoint/account entitlements; acquisition/refresh and account base discovery are external. Set exact allowed baseOrigin and accountId in node config or RuntimeConnection.config via builtin $connection; access token from credentials.accessToken or DOCUSIGN_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret. Per-node timeout 100–30000ms (default10000), beginning before profile/secrets through awaited successful stream cancellation. Profile timeoutMs does not extend the node deadline. Fixed routes/hosts, redirects forbidden, one request only, retries=0. External action: requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="DOCUSIGN CREATE-DRAFT". Reconcile uncertain outcomes before retrying. Always creates status=created, never sends. Choose documents plus signers OR templateId plus templateRoles; document content canonical base64 up to256KiB each, combined request512KiB. Arguments use direct typed sockets and the complete original request validator before credentials; result projects known typed fields only. DocuSign boolean flags/counters/IDs/tab values retain exact provider strings; optional absence differs from explicit null where declared. Response numeric JSON supports only lossless safe integer tokens; rejects fractional/exponent/unsafe tokens, even in unknown fields. Strict Unicode/UTF-8, dense JSON, depth40,100000 items, response1MiB/8192 chunks, lists100 unless documented nested bound. Paging count<=100 and start_position are explicit, defaults count100; returned nextUri is data only, never followed. Folder API has provider-defined page size; explicit start_position, no count/auto iteration. Metadata only, no document download or signed binary. No Connect listeners, signing, OAuth, auto send, arbitrary proxy, refresh, retries or auto pagination. Example: {"emailSubject":"synthetic-id"}. definitions.name: Docusign Send Envelope
definitions.documentation: Docusign Send Envelope: PUT /restapi/v2.1/accounts/{configured accountId}/envelopes/{envelopeId}. Externally issue OAuth access token with signature scope and endpoint/account entitlements; acquisition/refresh and account base discovery are external. Set exact allowed baseOrigin and accountId in node config or RuntimeConnection.config via builtin $connection; access token from credentials.accessToken or DOCUSIGN_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret. Per-node timeout 100–30000ms (default10000), beginning before profile/secrets through awaited successful stream cancellation. Profile timeoutMs does not extend the node deadline. Fixed routes/hosts, redirects forbidden, one request only, retries=0. External action: requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="DOCUSIGN SEND-ENVELOPE". Reconcile uncertain outcomes before retrying. Arguments use direct typed sockets and the complete original request validator before credentials; result projects known typed fields only. DocuSign boolean flags/counters/IDs/tab values retain exact provider strings; optional absence differs from explicit null where declared. Response numeric JSON supports only lossless safe integer tokens; rejects fractional/exponent/unsafe tokens, even in unknown fields. Strict Unicode/UTF-8, dense JSON, depth40,100000 items, response1MiB/8192 chunks, lists100 unless documented nested bound. Paging count<=100 and start_position are explicit, defaults count100; returned nextUri is data only, never followed. Folder API has provider-defined page size; explicit start_position, no count/auto iteration. Metadata only, no document download or signed binary. No Connect listeners, signing, OAuth, auto send, arbitrary proxy, refresh, retries or auto pagination. Example: {"envelopeId":"synthetic-id"}. definitions.name: Docusign Void Envelope
definitions.documentation: Docusign Void Envelope: PUT /restapi/v2.1/accounts/{configured accountId}/envelopes/{envelopeId}. Externally issue OAuth access token with signature scope and endpoint/account entitlements; acquisition/refresh and account base discovery are external. Set exact allowed baseOrigin and accountId in node config or RuntimeConnection.config via builtin $connection; access token from credentials.accessToken or DOCUSIGN_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret. Per-node timeout 100–30000ms (default10000), beginning before profile/secrets through awaited successful stream cancellation. Profile timeoutMs does not extend the node deadline. Fixed routes/hosts, redirects forbidden, one request only, retries=0. External action: requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="DOCUSIGN VOID-ENVELOPE". Reconcile uncertain outcomes before retrying. Arguments use direct typed sockets and the complete original request validator before credentials; result projects known typed fields only. DocuSign boolean flags/counters/IDs/tab values retain exact provider strings; optional absence differs from explicit null where declared. Response numeric JSON supports only lossless safe integer tokens; rejects fractional/exponent/unsafe tokens, even in unknown fields. Strict Unicode/UTF-8, dense JSON, depth40,100000 items, response1MiB/8192 chunks, lists100 unless documented nested bound. Paging count<=100 and start_position are explicit, defaults count100; returned nextUri is data only, never followed. Folder API has provider-defined page size; explicit start_position, no count/auto iteration. Metadata only, no document download or signed binary. No Connect listeners, signing, OAuth, auto send, arbitrary proxy, refresh, retries or auto pagination. Example: {"envelopeId":"synthetic-id","voidedReason":"synthetic-id"}. definitions.name: Docusign Resend Envelope Notifications
definitions.documentation: Docusign Resend Envelope Notifications: PUT /restapi/v2.1/accounts/{configured accountId}/envelopes/{envelopeId}. Externally issue OAuth access token with signature scope and endpoint/account entitlements; acquisition/refresh and account base discovery are external. Set exact allowed baseOrigin and accountId in node config or RuntimeConnection.config via builtin $connection; access token from credentials.accessToken or DOCUSIGN_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret. Per-node timeout 100–30000ms (default10000), beginning before profile/secrets through awaited successful stream cancellation. Profile timeoutMs does not extend the node deadline. Fixed routes/hosts, redirects forbidden, one request only, retries=0. External action: requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="DOCUSIGN RESEND-ENVELOPE". Reconcile uncertain outcomes before retrying. Arguments use direct typed sockets and the complete original request validator before credentials; result projects known typed fields only. DocuSign boolean flags/counters/IDs/tab values retain exact provider strings; optional absence differs from explicit null where declared. Response numeric JSON supports only lossless safe integer tokens; rejects fractional/exponent/unsafe tokens, even in unknown fields. Strict Unicode/UTF-8, dense JSON, depth40,100000 items, response1MiB/8192 chunks, lists100 unless documented nested bound. Paging count<=100 and start_position are explicit, defaults count100; returned nextUri is data only, never followed. Folder API has provider-defined page size; explicit start_position, no count/auto iteration. Metadata only, no document download or signed binary. No Connect listeners, signing, OAuth, auto send, arbitrary proxy, refresh, retries or auto pagination. Example: {"envelopeId":"synthetic-id"}. definitions.documentation: Docusign Add Envelope Recipients: POST /restapi/v2.1/accounts/{configured accountId}/envelopes/{envelopeId}/recipients. Externally issue OAuth access token with signature scope and endpoint/account entitlements; acquisition/refresh and account base discovery are external. Set exact allowed baseOrigin and accountId in node config or RuntimeConnection.config via builtin $connection; access token from credentials.accessToken or DOCUSIGN_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret. Per-node timeout 100–30000ms (default10000), beginning before profile/secrets through awaited successful stream cancellation. Profile timeoutMs does not extend the node deadline. Fixed routes/hosts, redirects forbidden, one request only, retries=0. External action: requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="DOCUSIGN ADD-ENVELOPE-RECIPIENTS". Reconcile uncertain outcomes before retrying. Arguments use direct typed sockets and the complete original request validator before credentials; result projects known typed fields only. DocuSign boolean flags/counters/IDs/tab values retain exact provider strings; optional absence differs from explicit null where declared. Response numeric JSON supports only lossless safe integer tokens; rejects fractional/exponent/unsafe tokens, even in unknown fields. Strict Unicode/UTF-8, dense JSON, depth40,100000 items, response1MiB/8192 chunks, lists100 unless documented nested bound. Paging count<=100 and start_position are explicit, defaults count100; returned nextUri is data only, never followed. Folder API has provider-defined page size; explicit start_position, no count/auto iteration. Metadata only, no document download or signed binary. No Connect listeners, signing, OAuth, auto send, arbitrary proxy, refresh, retries or auto pagination. Example: {"envelopeId":"synthetic-id"}. definitions.documentation: Docusign Update Envelope Recipients: PUT /restapi/v2.1/accounts/{configured accountId}/envelopes/{envelopeId}/recipients. Externally issue OAuth access token with signature scope and endpoint/account entitlements; acquisition/refresh and account base discovery are external. Set exact allowed baseOrigin and accountId in node config or RuntimeConnection.config via builtin $connection; access token from credentials.accessToken or DOCUSIGN_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret. Per-node timeout 100–30000ms (default10000), beginning before profile/secrets through awaited successful stream cancellation. Profile timeoutMs does not extend the node deadline. Fixed routes/hosts, redirects forbidden, one request only, retries=0. External action: requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="DOCUSIGN UPDATE-ENVELOPE-RECIPIENTS". Reconcile uncertain outcomes before retrying. Arguments use direct typed sockets and the complete original request validator before credentials; result projects known typed fields only. DocuSign boolean flags/counters/IDs/tab values retain exact provider strings; optional absence differs from explicit null where declared. Response numeric JSON supports only lossless safe integer tokens; rejects fractional/exponent/unsafe tokens, even in unknown fields. Strict Unicode/UTF-8, dense JSON, depth40,100000 items, response1MiB/8192 chunks, lists100 unless documented nested bound. Paging count<=100 and start_position are explicit, defaults count100; returned nextUri is data only, never followed. Folder API has provider-defined page size; explicit start_position, no count/auto iteration. Metadata only, no document download or signed binary. No Connect listeners, signing, OAuth, auto send, arbitrary proxy, refresh, retries or auto pagination. Example: {"envelopeId":"synthetic-id"}. definitions.name: Docusign List Folders
definitions.documentation: Docusign List Folders: GET /restapi/v2.1/accounts/{configured accountId}/folders. Externally issue OAuth access token with signature scope and endpoint/account entitlements; acquisition/refresh and account base discovery are external. Set exact allowed baseOrigin and accountId in node config or RuntimeConnection.config via builtin $connection; access token from credentials.accessToken or DOCUSIGN_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret. Per-node timeout 100–30000ms (default10000), beginning before profile/secrets through awaited successful stream cancellation. Profile timeoutMs does not extend the node deadline. Fixed routes/hosts, redirects forbidden, one request only, retries=0. Arguments use direct typed sockets and the complete original request validator before credentials; result projects known typed fields only. DocuSign boolean flags/counters/IDs/tab values retain exact provider strings; optional absence differs from explicit null where declared. Response numeric JSON supports only lossless safe integer tokens; rejects fractional/exponent/unsafe tokens, even in unknown fields. Strict Unicode/UTF-8, dense JSON, depth40,100000 items, response1MiB/8192 chunks, lists100 unless documented nested bound. Paging count<=100 and start_position are explicit, defaults count100; returned nextUri is data only, never followed. Folder API has provider-defined page size; explicit start_position, no count/auto iteration. Metadata only, no document download or signed binary. No Connect listeners, signing, OAuth, auto send, arbitrary proxy, refresh, retries or auto pagination. Example: {}. definitions.documentation: Docusign List Folder Items: GET /restapi/v2.1/accounts/{configured accountId}/folders/{folderId}. Externally issue OAuth access token with signature scope and endpoint/account entitlements; acquisition/refresh and account base discovery are external. Set exact allowed baseOrigin and accountId in node config or RuntimeConnection.config via builtin $connection; access token from credentials.accessToken or DOCUSIGN_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret. Per-node timeout 100–30000ms (default10000), beginning before profile/secrets through awaited successful stream cancellation. Profile timeoutMs does not extend the node deadline. Fixed routes/hosts, redirects forbidden, one request only, retries=0. Arguments use direct typed sockets and the complete original request validator before credentials; result projects known typed fields only. DocuSign boolean flags/counters/IDs/tab values retain exact provider strings; optional absence differs from explicit null where declared. Response numeric JSON supports only lossless safe integer tokens; rejects fractional/exponent/unsafe tokens, even in unknown fields. Strict Unicode/UTF-8, dense JSON, depth40,100000 items, response1MiB/8192 chunks, lists100 unless documented nested bound. Paging count<=100 and start_position are explicit, defaults count100; returned nextUri is data only, never followed. Folder API has provider-defined page size; explicit start_position, no count/auto iteration. Metadata only, no document download or signed binary. No Connect listeners, signing, OAuth, auto send, arbitrary proxy, refresh, retries or auto pagination. Example: {"folderId":"synthetic-id"}. definitions.name: Docusign Move Envelopes to Folder
definitions.documentation: Docusign Move Envelopes to Folder: PUT /restapi/v2.1/accounts/{configured accountId}/folders/{folderId}. Externally issue OAuth access token with signature scope and endpoint/account entitlements; acquisition/refresh and account base discovery are external. Set exact allowed baseOrigin and accountId in node config or RuntimeConnection.config via builtin $connection; access token from credentials.accessToken or DOCUSIGN_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret. Per-node timeout 100–30000ms (default10000), beginning before profile/secrets through awaited successful stream cancellation. Profile timeoutMs does not extend the node deadline. Fixed routes/hosts, redirects forbidden, one request only, retries=0. External action: requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="DOCUSIGN MOVE-FOLDER-ENVELOPES". Reconcile uncertain outcomes before retrying. Arguments use direct typed sockets and the complete original request validator before credentials; result projects known typed fields only. DocuSign boolean flags/counters/IDs/tab values retain exact provider strings; optional absence differs from explicit null where declared. Response numeric JSON supports only lossless safe integer tokens; rejects fractional/exponent/unsafe tokens, even in unknown fields. Strict Unicode/UTF-8, dense JSON, depth40,100000 items, response1MiB/8192 chunks, lists100 unless documented nested bound. Paging count<=100 and start_position are explicit, defaults count100; returned nextUri is data only, never followed. Folder API has provider-defined page size; explicit start_position, no count/auto iteration. Metadata only, no document download or signed binary. No Connect listeners, signing, OAuth, auto send, arbitrary proxy, refresh, retries or auto pagination. Example: {"folderId":"synthetic-id","envelopeIds":"synthetic-id"}.
